meta.definitions:
(exactly one per record):
  reviewed_draft   current content version has independent AI review evidence (blind solve without key) and no open hold
  pending_review   retained, but the current version lacks independent review (self-review only, new, or changed)
  hold             open hold carried from the baseline or raised since (revision, adjudication, blueprint)
  reserved_duplicate  excluded/reserved as a duplicate or template variant (baseline) or retired by a concept-repeat audit
  retired          withdrawn by this workstream after acceptance (superseded by a repair, or retired by audit)
No record is human-approved; difficulty is provisional throughout.

fresh_reviews.solver: blind AI solver A (separate agent, answer-free packet)
fresh_reviews.notes: She stops straightening right after the arrangement by size makes tools hard to find (three shelves to reach a wrench; hammer and nails on opposite sides). She then regroups the tools by task and accepts uneven rows and a gap. That supports C. B is the opposite of what she does (she reorganizes so tools are easier to find). A: nothing about visitors repairing shelves. D: nothing about closing; the room 'was working'. The passage gives enough context, and only one answer is defensible.
flags: minor: A and D have no support in the passage and are easy to eliminate; distractors overall are weak

fresh_reviews.solver: blind AI solver B (separate agent, answer-free packet)
fresh_reviews.notes: She stops straightening after the size-based order makes visitors walk past several shelves and puts hammer and nails on opposite sides. That evening she regroups tools by task and accepts uneven rows. This supports C: she is starting to doubt whether neatness helps visitors. A: nothing about visitors repairing shelves. B: the opposite, since she reorganizes so tools are easier to find. D: unsupported, because the library is working. 'Beginning to question' is suitably cautious for a choice made by noon. Exactly one defensible answer and the context is sufficient.
